audioReadingTool.title: Audio reading
audioReadingTool.subtitle: Paste a text, let the learner read aloud, and record audio. In this first beta, the recording stays in the browser while we test the flow before adding assessment, saving, and Space sharing.

source.lessonPickerHelp: Choose a lesson from My content. Title and text are filled in automatically.

record.title: Record reading
record.subtitle: Start recording when the text is ready. The learner can listen back before the next step.

listen.title: Practice with audio
listen.subtitle: Listen to the text before recording. This can support fluency, pronunciation, and confidence.

review.title: Beta assessment
review.subtitle: For now, the tool only gives simple support based on text length and recording time. A later version can transcribe audio and compare it with the source text.

signals.pending: Record audio to see a signal.
signals.short: The recording seems short compared with the text.
signals.long: The recording seems long compared with the text.
signals.ok: The recording time roughly fits the text.

checks.one: Listen for clear pronunciation and whether the words are in order.
checks.two: Notice whether the learner stops often or skips parts of the text.
checks.three: Use the feedback as support, not as a final grade.

next.title: Next connection
next.body: Planned: fetch text from Lessons, save to My content, assign in Space, and send audio for transcription/assessment.
